messages.subject: Merging tiles before differential methylation analysis in methylKit
messages.subject_clean: Merging tiles before differential methylation analysis in methylKit
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,
I want to do a Differential Methylated Region (DMR) analysis.
To do so I have used the tileMethylCounts function with the following parameters to create the regions:
PCa_NEPC_tiles <- tileMethylCounts(PCa_NEPC,win.size=200,step.size=50,cov.bases = 10)

My doubt comes when I want to merge overlapping intervals in a MethylRawList object, I do not find the way to do so. I know there is a function in GRanges (reduce()) that it works but I also have problemes going back from GRanges object to MethyRawList object so I can perform the subsecuent DMR analys with  getMethylDiff() function.

Thanks in advanced for all your help.

Uxue

messages.subject_clean: Merging tiles before differential methylation analysis in methylKit
messages.body_plain:
Hi Uxue,

Currently, there is no methylKit function to merge overlapping intervals. However, you can prepare the desired GRanges object and use the regionCounts() function to reconstruct your desired methylRawList object from those ranges and the original methylRawList object.

Best,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] diffMethPerChr - exclude and ideoDMC
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I want to calculate differential DNA methylation of between my data. I used Bwameth for alignment with reference genome. CpG reports were generated by MethylDackel Extractor. I have converted CpG reports into text format which was required for MethylKit input. I could not get a outputs at the chromosome level (outputs at the contig level). How should I proceed to get output at the chromosome level?

This Command:
>myDiff = calculateDiffMeth(meth)
> myDiff25p = getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25,qvalue = 0.01)
> diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = FALSE, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)
> diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = TRUE, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)

here is the top few lines of the output:

diffMeth.per.chr.chr           number.of.hypomethylated       percentage.of.hypomethylated      number.of.hypermethylated        percentage.of.hypermethylated

NC_039358.1                     1473                       1.6115445                             2577                    2.8193823
NC_039359.1                     1144                       1.6317681                             2042
 2.9126491                   2.9126491

Thank you for your help,
Tuba

Hi Tuba,

This question is unrelated to methylKit, but here is a suggested approach to go from contig to chromosome: https://www.biostars.org/p/9565600/.
See here about the relationship between contigs and chromosomes: http://www.ensembl.org/info/genome/genebuild/chromosomes_scaffolds_contigs.html .

Best
Alex

Hi,
I am having the following error when I try to annotate the differentially methylated regions with the "annotateWithGeneParts" function.

Specifically, the error is :

> gene.parts = readTranscriptFeatures("/rds/project/hgTables")
Reading the table...
Calculating intron coordinates...
Calculating exon coordinates...
Calculating TSS coordinates...
Calculating promoter coordinates...
Outputting the final GRangesList...

> load("myDiff.RData")

> annotateWithGeneParts(as(myDiff25p,"GRanges"),gene.parts)
 *** caught segfault ***
address (nil), cause 'unknown'

address (nil), cause 'unknown'

 1: data.table::fread(file = filepath, ...)

Hg Table comes from UCSC, I would be very grateful if anyone could point me to the reason behind this error message.
Many thanks
Selma.
